# Transforming text

New strings made from old: concatenation, repetition, replacement and ASCII case.

<h2 id="concat"><code>Concat</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Concat(
    allocator: Allocator,
    left: StringView,
    right: StringView
) -> String ! TextError
```

The text of `left` followed by the text of `right`.
Fails with what went wrong; no partial text comes back.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/Transform.rux#L19)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type         | Description                  |
| ----------- | ------------ | ---------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator`  | where the storage comes from |
| `left`      | `StringView` | the first piece              |
| `right`     | `StringView` | the second                   |

**Returns**: the two joined, or why they could not be

<h2 id="repeat"><code>Repeat</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Repeat(
    allocator: Allocator,
    view: StringView,
    count: uint
) -> String ! TextError
```

The text of `view` written `count` times.
A `count` of zero gives empty text, which is what makes repeating agree with joining: repeating twice is the
same as joining a thing to itself.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/Transform.rux#L35)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type         | Description                  |
| ----------- | ------------ | ---------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator`  | where the storage comes from |
| `view`      | `StringView` | the borrowed text to act on  |
| `count`     | `uint`       | how many times               |

**Returns**: the text repeated that many times, or why it could not be

<h2 id="replace"><code>Replace</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Replace(
    allocator: Allocator,
    view: StringView,
    needle: StringView,
    replacement: StringView
) -> String ! TextError
```

The text of `view` with every occurrence of `needle` replaced by `replacement`.
Occurrences are found left to right and never overlap, and what is put in their place is not searched again --
so replacing `a` with `aa` terminates rather than growing forever. An empty `needle` matches nothing, since the
alternative is a replacement between every pair of characters and before and after every one of them.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/Transform.rux#L61)

**Parameters**

| Name          | Type         | Description                  |
| ------------- | ------------ | ---------------------------- |
| `allocator`   | `Allocator`  | where the storage comes from |
| `view`        | `StringView` | the borrowed text to act on  |
| `needle`      | `StringView` | the text to look for         |
| `replacement` | `StringView` | the text to put in its place |

**Returns**: the text with every occurrence replaced, or why it could not be

<h2 id="to-ascii-upper"><code>ToAsciiUpper</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ToAsciiUpper(
    allocator: Allocator,
    view: StringView
) -> String ! TextError
```

The text of `view` with every ASCII lower-case letter raised, and everything else left alone.
ASCII only: every byte above 0x7F passes through untouched, which is why this cannot change the length and
cannot produce anything that is not UTF-8.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/Transform.rux#L103)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type         | Description                  |
| ----------- | ------------ | ---------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator`  | where the storage comes from |
| `view`      | `StringView` | the borrowed text to act on  |

**Returns**: the text with its ASCII letters uppercased and everything else untouched

<h2 id="to-ascii-lower"><code>ToAsciiLower</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ToAsciiLower(
    allocator: Allocator,
    view: StringView
) -> String ! TextError
```

The text of `view` with every ASCII upper-case letter lowered.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/Transform.rux#L112)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type         | Description                  |
| ----------- | ------------ | ---------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator`  | where the storage comes from |
| `view`      | `StringView` | the borrowed text to act on  |

**Returns**: the text with its ASCII letters lowercased and everything else untouched
